note: Provenance manifest for third-party food datasets staged under data/raw/. The archives themselves are git-ignored; this manifest is committed so every download is reproducible and every derived value is traceable. Add one entry per raw artifact, with its sha256, before using it. Verify with: shasum -a 256 <path>

artifacts.license: Public domain (USDA FoodData Central data are not copyrighted; attribution requested)
artifacts.notes: Smallest and highest-quality tier: lab-analysed single ingredients with full analytical provenance. Best starting point for the catalog.

artifacts.notes: ~11.9 GiB gzipped. JSONL, so it streams line by line and never needs full decompression — decompressing to disk is not an option on this machine (see below). Global crowd-sourced barcode data: coverage is broad but quality is uneven and per-field completeness varies wildly. Filter by countries_tags for Turkish products.

usage.decision: Owner's decision, 2026-08-23: this is a local, non-distributed case study. The app is not shipped, published or otherwise distributed in any form. Every share-alike / redistribution clause below (ODbL for Open Food Facts, the TÜRKOMP site terms) is triggered by distribution, so none of them apply as long as this holds. The license fields are kept for the record only. Revisit them if, and only if, the app is ever distributed.
